faulty_vehicles.note: Sensor stuck on MANY_SEATS with low ride-window coverage — crowding data may be unreliable

boardings.published_note: Route-periods marked 'published' use MiWay's 2024 APC report as a fallback because the live estimator could not compute boardings (sensor only reports MANY_SEATS with no variation).

rider_impact.weighting_note: Weighted totals scale each ghost's extra wait by the route's worst standing-or-worse share + 1: on a crowded route the next bus inherits the missed load, so riders feel the gap more than the schedule suggests. Unweighted totals are unchanged.

phantoms.note: Trips that ghost on >60% of days are likely schedule discrepancies (deadheads, stale GTFS entries) rather than real missing buses.  Excluded from rider-impact.

ghost_trips.note: Ghost % is only meaningful for days with ≥50% coverage — low-coverage days undercount. Ghosts sharing a GTFS block are grouped as one likely pulled bus, not N separate cancellations.
